messages.text: 看向远方，让眼睛休息一下。
messages.englishText: Look into the distance. Give your eyes a rest.

messages.text: 站起来，伸个懒腰，喝一杯水。
messages.englishText: Stand up, stretch, and have some water.
Relax your shoulders. Take a slow breath.
Step away from the screen. Take a little walk 🌿
Empty the mind; remain deeply still.
Know when to pause, and find your calm.
A journey of a thousand miles begins beneath your feet.
The way of balance is to alternate tension and relaxation.

messages.text: 知之者不如好之者，好之者不如乐之者。
messages.englishText: Knowing is less than loving; loving is less than finding joy.

messages.text: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
messages.englishText: Human follows earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows the Way, and the Way follows nature.
Among any three people walking together, there is someone I can learn from.
It flows on like this, never ceasing day or night.
